title: Hyperspace Jump (easy)
statementMd:
The Rebel fleet is on the run. It consists of $*m*$ ships currently gathered around a single planet. Just a few seconds ago, the vastly more powerful Empire fleet has appeared in the same solar system, and the Rebels will need to escape into hyperspace. In order to spread the fleet, the captain of each ship has independently come up with the coordinate to which that ship will jump. In the obsolete navigation system used by the Rebels, this coordinate is given as the value of an arithmetic expression of the form ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3d4d95f2669ed832926be0ef1c09fdbc72a99998.png).

To plan the future of the resistance movement, Princess Heidi needs to know, for each ship, how many ships are going to end up at the same coordinate after the jump. You are her only hope!

## Input

The first line of the input contains a single integer $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ 200 000$) – the number of ships. The next $*m*$ lines describe one jump coordinate each, given as an arithmetic expression. An expression has the form `(a+b)/c`. Namely, it consists of: an opening parenthesis `(`, a positive integer $*a*$ of up to two decimal digits, a plus sign `+`, a positive integer $*b*$ of up to two decimal digits, a closing parenthesis `)`, a slash `/`, and a positive integer $*c*$ of up to two decimal digits.

## Output

Print a single line consisting of $*m*$ space-separated integers. The $*i*$-th integer should be equal to the number of ships whose coordinate is equal to that of the $*i*$-th ship (including the $*i*$-th ship itself).

## Note

In the sample testcase, the second and the third ship will both end up at the coordinate $3$.

Note that this problem has only two versions – easy and hard.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

叛军舰队正在逃亡。舰队由 $*m*$ 艘飞船组成，目前聚集在同一颗行星附近。就在几秒前，实力强大得多的帝国舰队出现在同一恒星系中，叛军必须逃入超空间。为了分散舰队，每艘飞船的舰长都独立决定了该飞船将要跳跃到的坐标。在叛军使用的过时导航系统中，这个坐标表示为如下形式的算术表达式的值：[图片](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3d4d95f2669ed832926be0ef1c09fdbc72a99998.png)。

为了规划抵抗运动的未来，Heidi 公主需要知道，对于每艘飞船，跳跃后将有多少艘飞船最终位于相同的坐标。你是她唯一的希望！

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 200 000$），表示飞船的数量。接下来的 $*m*$ 行分别描述一个跳跃坐标，每个坐标由一个算术表达式给出。表达式的形式为 `(a+b)/c`。也就是说，它由以下部分组成：左括号 `(`、一个最多包含两位十进制数字的正整数 $*a*$、加号 `+`、一个最多包含两位十进制数字的正整数 $*b*$、右括号 `)`、斜杠 `/`，以及一个最多包含两位十进制数字的正整数 $*c*$。

## 输出格式

输出一行，包含 $*m*$ 个由空格分隔的整数。第 $*i*$ 个整数应等于坐标与第 $*i*$ 艘飞船相同的飞船数量（包括第 $*i*$ 艘飞船自身）。

## 说明

在样例测试中，第二艘和第三艘飞船最终都会位于坐标 $3$。

请注意，本题只有两个版本——简单版和困难版。
